Definition: properly, to be flabby, i.e. (by implication) desist; (figuratively) be lacking or idle
BiblicalUsage: Chadal means to cease, to leave off, to forbear. The builders of Babel left off building the city when God scattered them, Moses said the thunder would cease when he prayed, the man who forbears to keep the passover is cut off, and the poor will never cease out of the land.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe ceasing is God's work and man's duty in turn: He stops the thunder, He stops the tower, and He tells us never to stop opening our hands to the poor. The poor never cease, and neither should our open hands.
RelatedEvents: The Tower of Babel; The Plague of Hail
